info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Securities Position Keeping API
info.description: The Securities Position Keeping API provides essential functionalities for managing and tracking securities positions within an account. This API enables organizations to retrieve current information about their securities holdings, including details on quantity, value, and performance metrics. Financial institutions, asset managers, and investment firms typically use this API to ensure accurate records and facilitate effective portfolio management. By integrating this API, users can maintain a comprehensive view of their investment positions and make informed decisions based on up-to-date data.

get.summary: Retrieve the securities position from account management.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current securities position associated with their account management. It provides detailed information about all securities held, including quantities, valuations, and any pertinent transaction history.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the securities position keeping information. It should include all necessary parameters to specify the desired account and securities details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the securities position details.

GetSecuritiesPositionKeepingRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving information about securities positions in the account management system.
